@deskOwnYourNode.description: Name of the user's own node (on this computer, the home network, a VPN or their own server) on the sidebar status row and in its tooltip, where a public node shows its host.

@deskOwnLabel.description: Label of the user's own node on its panel and its row in the node list. {where} is deskOwnClassThisComputer, deskOwnClassHome, deskOwnClassVpn or the host of their own server.

@deskOwnClassThisComputer.description: Where the user's own node runs: on this computer (localhost). After 'Your node · '. Lowercase.

@deskOwnClassHome.description: Where the user's own node runs: on the local (home) network, a 192.168.x.x or .lan address. After 'Your node · '. Lowercase.

@deskOwnClassVpn.description: Where the user's own node runs: reached over a VPN such as Tailscale. After 'Your node · '. Keep 'VPN'.

@deskOwnFactMempool.description: Label of a fact on the own node's panel: the transactions waiting in the node's memory pool. One short word.

@deskOwnPoolEmpty.description: Value of the Mempool fact when no transaction waits. Lowercase.

@deskOwnPoolWaiting.description: Value of the Mempool fact: this many transactions wait in the node's mempool.

deskOwnSourceSite: Asked directly every 15 s · tip from {site}

@deskOwnSourceSite.description: Source line under the own node's facts: the app asks the node itself every 15 seconds; the network tip it compares with comes from the status site.

deskOwnSourceNodes: {count, plural, one{Asked directly every 15 s · tip from 1 public node} other{Asked directly every 15 s · tip from {count} public nodes}}

@deskOwnSourceNodes.description: Source line under the own node's facts when the status site does not answer: the network tip is the median of this many public nodes.

deskOwnSourceNone: Asked directly every 15 s · no network tip to compare with

@deskOwnSourceNone.description: Source line under the own node's facts when no network tip is known (status site and public nodes unreachable).

deskOwnSyncingLine: The wallet cannot send or receive through it until it is synced

@deskOwnSyncingLine.description: Tooltip line of the sidebar node row while the user's own node syncs.

@deskOwnAccess.description: Title of the row on the own node's panel for the node's owner secret (.api_secret), which unlocks peers and sync details.

deskOwnAccessHint: The node’s owner secret shows its sync stage and peers here and lets you ban a peer. It is kept in this computer’s keyring, never in the settings or the wallet data file.

@deskOwnAccessHint.description: Hint behind the info icon of the Owner access row.

@deskOwnAccessNotSet.description: State of the Owner access row: no secret added.

@deskOwnAccessOn.description: State of the Owner access row: the secret is added and the node takes it.

@deskOwnAccessRefused.description: State of the Owner access row: the node refuses the stored secret (its owner changed it) since this time (HH:MM).

@deskOwnAccessRefusedBadge.description: Warn badge on the Owner access row when the node refuses the stored secret. One word.

deskOwnAccessTor: Not used while Tor is on

@deskOwnAccessTor.description: State of the Owner access row for the user's own https server while the Tor switch is on: the secret is never sent over Tor.

deskOwnAccessNote: Peers and sync details come from the node’s owner API.

@deskOwnAccessNote.description: Note under the own node's status tiles once owner access is added.

@deskOwnAdd.description: Button on the Owner access row: opens the dialog to add the node's secret.

@deskOwnUpdate.description: Button on the Owner access row when the node refuses the stored secret: enter the new one.

@deskOwnRemove.description: Button on the Owner access row: forget the stored secret (the node stays in the list).

@deskOwnAdded.description: Toast after the node took the secret.

@deskOwnRemoved.description: Toast after the stored secret was forgotten.

@deskOwnDlgTitle.description: Title of the dialog that adds the node's owner secret. {host} is the node's address with port.

deskOwnDlgWhere: The secret is the first line of the file .api_secret in the node’s data folder (~/.epic/main on the node’s computer).

@deskOwnDlgWhere.description: Description of the Owner access dialog: where the secret is. Keep .api_secret and ~/.epic/main as they are.

@deskOwnDlgPaste.description: Label of the password field in the Owner access dialog.

@deskOwnDlgPick.description: Button in the Owner access dialog (node on this computer only): choose the .api_secret file; also the file dialog's title.

@deskOwnDlgFileRead.description: Line under the secret field after a file was picked. {file} is the file name.

@deskOwnDlgFileEmpty.description: Error under the secret field: the picked file is empty or unreadable.

deskOwnDlgPlainTitle: The secret travels unencrypted on the home network

@deskOwnDlgPlainTitle.description: Warn notice title in the Owner access dialog for a plain-http node on the home network.

deskOwnDlgPlainText: On a shared network, reach the node over a VPN or https, or run the wallet on the node’s computer.

@deskOwnDlgPlainText.description: Warn notice text in the Owner access dialog for a plain-http node on the home network.

deskOwnDlgPlainAgain: Do not show again for this node

@deskOwnDlgPlainAgain.description: Checkbox under the plain-http warning in the Owner access dialog.

@deskOwnDlgRefused.description: Error under the secret field: the node answered 401 to the secret.

deskOwnDlgNoAnswer: The node did not answer; the secret was kept

@deskOwnDlgNoAnswer.description: Toast after adding a secret while the node did not answer: it is kept and checked again later.

@deskOwnDlgAdd.description: Primary button of the Owner access dialog: check the secret and keep it.

@deskOwnDownTitle.description: Risk notice title on the own node's panel while a public node stands in for it.

deskOwnDownText: The wallet uses {host} meanwhile and moves back after this node answers twice in a row.

@deskOwnDownText.description: Risk notice text on the own node's panel. {host} is the public node standing in.

@deskOwnUsingMeanwhile.description: Detail after 'Not answering' in the own node's panel head. {host} is the public node standing in. Lowercase start.

@deskOwnUsingUntilSynced.description: Detail after 'Syncing' in the own node's panel head while a public node stands in. Lowercase start.

@deskOwnTryNow.description: Button on the not-answering notice: ask the own node again now and move back when it answers.

@deskOwnUseForGood.description: Button on the not-answering notice: make the standing-in public node the chosen one. {host} is its host.

deskOwnSyncTitle: Use a public node until this node is synced?

@deskOwnSyncTitle.description: Notice title on the own node's panel while it syncs and nothing was answered yet.

deskOwnSyncText: {host} can stand in until this node is synced.

@deskOwnSyncText.description: Notice text on the own node's panel while it syncs. {host} is the public node that would stand in.

@deskOwnWaitForMine.description: Button: keep the wallet on the own node while it syncs (no public node).

deskOwnSyncUsingTitle: Using {host} until this node is synced

@deskOwnSyncUsingTitle.description: Info notice title on the own node's panel while a public node stands in for the syncing own node.

deskOwnSyncUsingText: The wallet moves back once this node accepts transactions.

@deskOwnMine.description: Switch row in Settings › Node for an https node: the user runs it. Then the app asks it directly and offers owner access.

deskOwnMineHint: Asks the node itself instead of {site} and offers owner access. For a node you run yourself.

@deskOwnMineHint.description: Hint behind the info icon of the 'This is my node' row.

@deskOwnSlotSyncing.description: Line in the sidebar's now-happening slot while the user's own node syncs; the detail is a percent or 'N behind'.

deskOwnAccessOnPlain: Added · goes to the node unencrypted (plain http), readable on that network

@deskOwnAccessOnPlain.description: Text of the Owner access row when the secret is added and the node is reached over plain http on the home network or a tailnet: the secret travels unencrypted on each owner call. Starts with deskOwnAccessOn's word.
